name: SEO Tracker
body:
> Project · 2026-10-08

# Summary
The TAG Visibility Tracker: an internal SEO / AEO / GEO tracker for Summit AZ, Pipeliners and Alphalete, published as a claude.ai artifact with a database (claude.ai/artifact/EG3VPHpDNrJeTSbaRngYYe). Refreshed on demand only ("refresh the SEO tracker"), read-only against [Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas) and [Keystone CRM](lib:brain-keystone-crm). `SEO-Tracker\` holds the page source, build scripts, snapshots, change records and lead exports.

# Data model
- `snapshots/{site}_{date}`: per-site refresh with **SEO** (GSC clicks, impressions, CTR, position, rank distribution, keywords, pages, page-two keywords), **AEO** (Google AI Mode visibility and cited URLs) and **GEO** (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Grok visibility, share of voice, competitors), plus errors and notes.
- `changes`: page-change tracking for the Updates tab, with before/after GSC windows and a verdict. 31 Pipeliners change records (Sep 1 to 28, 2026: city pages, service pages, blog batches) are stored in `changes\`.
- `worklog` and `leads/{site}`.
- Rank projects: Summit 84536, Pipeliners 34164, Alphalete 82050. LLM visibility project IDs are in the README [redacted here]; the Pipeliners one is a default auto project with only 15 queries and needs fixing.

# Features added over time (README)
Chrome fallback when the Search Atlas connector failed (Sep 29); page-two keywords; Updates tab (Sep 30); live "Refresh from Search Console" button, 7/28/30-day and custom periods with baselines, and a Leads tab (Oct 6); design command bar with picture input (Oct 8); "Shell v2" Instantly-style layout, dark by default (Oct 8, version 32 to 33).

# Leads (counts only)
All three sites' leads now come from Keystone (Oct 7); the older GHL `pull_leads.py` is kept for reference only. Exports in `leads\` (Jan 1 to Oct 6 or 7, 2026, fields: date, channel, how, page, stage, value; no names, phones or emails):
- Alphalete: 17 SEO leads (of 97 real leads in Keystone).
- Pipeliners: 132 rows.
- Summit AZ: 145 rows.
SEO counts organic search and non-ad Google Business Profile sources.

# Files (rollup)
- `seo-tracker.html` (live page source) plus several dated `.bak.html` versions (not noted separately).
- Scripts: `build_snapshots.py`, `build_page2.py`, `keystone_leads.py`, `pull_leads.py`, `add_updates_tab.py`, `apply_shell_v2.py`, `apply_images.py`, `add_logos.py`.
- `command-bar.html`, `shell-v2.css`, `seed-worklog.json`, `page-two-keywords-2026-09.csv`, `snapshots\` (Sep 29 snapshots and page-two data).

# Pending
- The artifact was set to "anyone with the link" at one point; make it private if not intended.
- Fix the Pipeliners LLM visibility project (only 15 auto queries).
